access_check.rule: A GET of https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/full-index/ with the declared user agent; only the status is kept, outside the probe and its journals. It runs once before the freeze, once right before --run and once before acknowledging any 403 or 429. Acknowledge only when that GET returns 200 and it is the attempt's first acknowledged 403 or 429; otherwise stop and re-plan. The probe can never request this URL itself (outside the allowed prefix). An acknowledged 403 is permanent for its URL and its event stays in the denominators as unavailable.
